connection: On the computer you want to use, install or open Agent Zero Launcher. Choose Connect to an existing server and sign in to this same server. Open its Instance tab and select the computer icon. A remote server does not require Docker on this computer. To create a local server instead, choose Create instance and follow Launcher's runtime setup.
browser: In Launcher, select Use my browser and Allow selected access. Select Prepare browser and follow its instructions. For Safari, enable web developer features in Advanced settings, then Allow remote automation in Developer settings. Chromium browsers may ask you to allow remote debugging. Choose your browser in Advanced settings if needed. Test browser opens a temporary page, checks typing and capture, then closes that page.
computer_use: In Launcher, select Use my computer and Allow selected access. Follow Check computer permissions. On macOS, approve Accessibility before Screen Recording, then return to Launcher after each prompt. Restart only when requested. Windows and Linux use their own permission or desktop-sharing prompts. Test computer checks a fresh capture without clicking or typing in another app; approve any system prompt yourself.
routing: Open Browser settings in this server's WebUI and select the host browser for tasks that must use your computer. Project-specific settings can override the server default. Keep the selected instance open in Launcher and the computer awake. Take over pauses host actions; Return to A0 hands control back. If an action needs review, inspect the computer before continuing.
